description:
No spec subject (candidates: specled.severity / CLI output surface when picked up). Severity: Low. From 2026-08-06 critical review of specled_-q0q. The new append_only/self_authorized_weakening marker resolves to :info, and default CLI output does not render :info findings — the always-visible marker the epic shipped is in practice visible only in HTML review output or verbose modes. Keep-reason: CLI output-policy change (how :info renders by default) needs its own small design call; out of scope for the defect branch. Concrete failure: a maintainer running bare mix spec.check on a self-authorizing PR sees a green result with no marker line, defeating the visibility intent.

## ORCHESTRATOR CONTRACT (specled_-i4x)

Advances: specled.mix_tasks

(Orchestrator note: NOT specled.severity — nothing about severity RESOLUTION changes, only
stdout filtering. Not specled.branch_guard unless branch_check.ex is touched, which it should
not be. specled.mix_tasks owns lib/mix/tasks/spec.check.ex, .spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md:22.)

THIS TICKET'S PREMISE IS MATERIALLY OVERSTATED — re-scope before implementing. The
concrete-failure claim ("a maintainer running bare mix spec.check sees a green result with no
marker line") is wrong on the second half. print_branch_report/2
(lib/mix/tasks/spec.check.ex:252-257) ALWAYS prints the info count plus an explicit visibility
disclosure:

  branch base=... findings=N (error=E warning=W info=I, info hidden; --verbose to show)

That line landed in 134d0e8d (0.8.0), five releases before 0.13.0, and is a spec'd must —
specled.tasks.branch_findings_breakdown (.spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md:292-301). What is
genuinely hidden is the marker's DETAIL line (which requirement, which ADR), suppressed by
filter_for_stdout/2 (lib/mix/tasks/spec.check.ex:216-224). The ticket also says --debug; the
flag is --verbose, plus SPECLED_SHOW_INFO=1 (lib/mix/tasks/spec.check.ex:207-213).

CORRECT FRAMING: the count is disclosed, the detail is not. The design call is whether specific
:info codes get an always-on carve-out from filter_for_stdout/2.

DECISION-CLASS: yes — spec amendment required. The ticket does NOT self-describe this, and this
is the one most likely to ambush you mid-implementation. specled.tasks.check_verbose_flag
(.spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md:185-188) is a must reading "findings whose resolved severity is
:info shall be suppressed from stdout" — UNCONDITIONAL. Any always-visible carve-out contradicts
it verbatim. Because the amendment removes an absolute from a must,
append_only/must_downgraded or scenario_regression may fire and require an authorizing ADR with
change_type: adds-exception, affects: [specled.tasks.check_verbose_flag]. Per operator ruling on
epic specled_-i4x: draft fully, record completion normally; the orchestrator will NOT merge
without human sign-off.

Allowed touches:
- lib/mix/tasks/spec.check.ex
- .spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md
- .spec/decisions/specled.decision.*.md
- test/mix/tasks/spec_check_test.exs
- test/mix/tasks/spec_tasks_test.exs
- .spec/realization_hashes.json  (Mix.Tasks.Spec.Check.run/1 is a tracked api_boundary binding.
  Post-0.14.0 a body edit inside run/1 should NOT move it — hashing is head + arg shapes only,
  lib/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary.ex:51-57 — but it is listed so you are not blocked.)
- docs/concepts.md, README.md  (only if flag semantics are taught there)
- CHANGELOG.md

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex
- lib/specled_ex/branch_check/severity.ex
- lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex
- lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex

Out of Scope (intent):
- Do NOT raise append_only/self_authorized_weakening from :info to :warning. That changes
  exit-status math and defeats "visible but not blocked"
  (lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex:523-540).
- Do NOT change the summary-line format. It is pinned verbatim by a must and by scenario
  specled.tasks.branch_findings_breakdown.summary_and_order.
- Do NOT make --verbose the default. specled.package docs instruct adopters to use --verbose to
  probe for detector_unavailable (.spec/specs/package.spec.md:26-29); inverting silently
  invalidates that instruction.
- Do NOT change validation-finding filtering unless your design call covers both paths — they
  share filter_for_stdout/2.

Verification:
  mix test test/mix/tasks/spec_check_test.exs test/mix/tasks/spec_tasks_test.exs
  mix compile --warnings-as-errors
  mix format --check-formatted
  mix spec.check --no-run-commands
  bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
Those two files are the only ones carrying check_verbose_flag / branch_findings_breakdown tags.
No stub to flip.

Expected diff: ~60-110 lines across 4-6 files.
title: F25: :info findings invisible on default CLI output — self-auth marker only visible with --debug/HTML
